title: release-train weekly prep notes - Maya Singh - 2026-02-27
content:
Release train weekly prep notes (working pad)
Owner: Maya Singh
Meeting: Release Train Weekly Sync (go/no-go) \u2014 2026-03-04 09:00 PT

Purpose: quick status capture for the go/no-go decision. keep it short, call out blockers and owners.

Agenda draft:
- Quick status round (infra, runtime, model, infra-qos, QA, docs, legal/compliance) \u2014 2 min each
- Go/no-go signals and escalation path \u2014 5 min
- Open blockers + action owners \u2014 10 min
- Rollback/fallback confirmation and smoke checklist \u2014 3 min
- Post-launch monitoring and on-call rota \u2014 2 min

High-level status (recommended quick summary for meeting):
- Overall: ON TRACK (green) but one mid-priority blocker in canary perf spikes (infra autoscale).

Checklist (owners + status notes):
1) Model version pinned and validated
   - Owner: Olivia Martin
   - Status: done
   - Notes: Verified model v3.2.1 pinned in deployment config; evals pass baseline quality. Confluence run: Release 42 runbook page.

2) Serving runtime & kernel rollout
   - Owner: Samir Patel
   - Status: in_progress
   - Notes: New kernel (kv-cache optimization) staged on dedicated pool. Canary traffic showing intermittent 15-20% p90 latency regression on longer seqs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482
   - Action: Samir to triage telemetry and reduce batch size for canary (due 2026-03-04 10:30 PT).

3) Autoscaling / capacity (Dedicated pool)
   - Owner: Ethan Park
   - Status: blocker
   - Notes: Autoscaler threshold config RL-2168 not applied to prod-dedicated; during canary spike nodes didn't scale fast enough. Ops runbook updated but need immediate parameter flip.
   - Action: Ethan to coordinate with infra (runbook step) and apply temp threshold change before release window (due 2026-03-04 09:45 PT). If not done, fallback: reduce canary to 30% or delay release.

4) Canary tests & QA signoff
   - Owner: Priya Kapoor (QA lead) \u2014 collaborator not listed above but invited to meeting
   - Status: in_progress
   - Notes: Regression suite 1/3 failing \u2014 intermittent memory leak observed on long chat sessions. Investigating.
   - Action: QA to provide failing test cases + heap dumps by EOD; engineering to triage.

5) Telemetry and alerting checks
   - Owner: SRE oncall (Olivia backup: Luke Wu)
   - Status: done (smoke verified)
   - Notes: Dashboards for p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, error-rate. Pager escalation documented in runbook.

6) Docs and release notes
   - Owner: Maya Singh
   - Status: in_progress
   - Notes: Draft release notes ready; need final PR review for breaking change note. Linked artifacts: confluence + PR to docs.
   - Action: Maya to merge release notes PR by 2026-03-04 08:30 PT.

7) Compliance & legal review (private deployments)
   - Owner: Legal (informed) / Security: Aisha Rahman
   - Status: done (no new data controls required for this release)

Go / No-go decision signals (suggested):
- Must: model pinned + canary regression <= 2% of error-rate and autoscaler parameter applied OR mitigation plan in place.
- Should: QA regressions triaged with owner + temporary rollback plan verified.
- Nice-to-have: docs merged and customer comms scheduled.

Current go/no-go recommendation: HOLD (pending autoscaler change + canary perf triage).

Open blockers (short):
- Autoscaler threshold not applied (Owner: Ethan Park) \u2014 BLOCKER
- Canary p90 latency spike with new kernel (Owner: Samir Patel) \u2014 INVESTIGATING
- QA regression intermittent memory leak (Owner: Priya Kapoor) \u2014 INVESTIGATING

Immediate actions before meeting (owners + due times):
- Ethan: apply temp autoscaler threshold tweak (due 09:45 PT)
- Samir: triage canary telemetry + attempt batch size tweak (due 10:30 PT)
- Priya: isolate failing test + upload heap dump to /shared/tmp (due EOD)
- Maya: finalize release notes PR and add rollback instructions (due 08:30 PT)
- Olivia: confirm SLO alert thresholds and oncall rota (done)

Escalation path:
- If autoscaler change fails: consider rolling back runtime kernel change or reducing canary traffic to 10% and re-evaluate after 2 hours.
- Pager: oncall SRE (primary) -> SRE manager -> Eng Leads.

Notes to self / meeting prep reminders:
- Bring exact numbers for canary (p50/p90/p99) and Node spin-up times (from infra metrics)
- Keep decision crisp: list the single blocking item(s) and proposed mitigation
- Confirm comms plan for customers if we delay or rollback (who's owning external message?)

Follow-ups (post meeting):
- Collect root cause notes and link to RL-2145 for tracking
- Update runbook with any temporary knobs we flipped during release
- Postmortem owner assignment if we do rollback

Misc links / refs:
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Release+42+runbook
- Infra ticket: RL-2168
- Kernel PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482
- Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/199

Questions I still have (to ask in meeting):
- If autoscaler parameter flip is risky, do we prefer to rollback runtime kernel instead? (cost vs risk tradeoff)
- Who will send customer comms if we delay? (suggest: Product ops owns, engineer + comms pairing)

-- end working notes --
